coplace.title: CoPlace
coplace.description: Collaborative real-time Pixel Art creation platform. Users can authenticate, discover or create custom rooms using slugs, and draw together on an interactive canvas with a complete color palette.

functions.title: User Authentication
functions.description: Secure login system enabling users to access their accounts, manage their creations, and enter drawing rooms with their profile.

functions.title: Sign Up with Password Validation
functions.description: Intuitive registration form with real-time security rules, requiring at least 8 characters, uppercase, lowercase, and special characters.

functions.title: Lobby & Room Search
functions.description: Dynamic search for canvas rooms directly from the interface or via URL slug (e.g. /canvas/bnv), featuring active session display and logout.

functions.title: Collaborative Canvas & Color Palette
functions.description: Real-time interactive pixel grid with a rich color palette, allowing multiple users to draw and create pixel art in synchronization.
